# ErcoleDev, Federico Ercole

> Federico Ercole is a Senior Software Engineer based in Vienna, Austria, with ten years of
> experience in real-time AI platforms, large distributed systems on AWS and full-stack product
> development. He is available for freelance projects, sold as fixed-scope and fixed-price packages.

- Website: https://www.ercole.dev
- Contact: federico@ercole.dev
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/federicoercole
- GitHub: https://github.com/sercinci
- Location: Vienna, Austria. Works remotely across Europe.
- Languages: English, German, Italian, Romanian, French.

## Freelance packages

Prices are fixed and include the deliverables listed. Payment is 50% upfront and 50% on delivery,
invoiced from the European Union. Timelines are calendar weeks and assume part-time availability
alongside a main role.

- **AI Voice Agent PoC. €2,900, 3 weeks.** A working browser-based voice agent using a
  speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipeline, one use case of the client's choice, the client's
  knowledge base wired in, latency tuning and a provider cost breakdown, deployed on a demo URL,
  plus a handover document and a 60 minute walkthrough call.
- **Agentic AI Enablement. €1,800, 2 to 3 weeks.** One production-ready agent or automation built
  inside the client's stack, with custom skills, tools and prompt setup versioned in their repo, a
  90 minute team enablement session and a runbook.
- **Cloud Architecture Review. €1,400, 2 weeks.** An independent review of the client's cloud
  infrastructure: an architecture diagram, a written audit covering cost, reliability, security and
  scalability, a fix list prioritised by effort against impact, and a 90 minute walkthrough call.
- **Business Landing Site. €1,200, 2 weeks.** A one-page responsive Next.js website of up to six
  sections, with SEO metadata, sitemap, analytics, a working contact form, deployment, domain
  connection and two rounds of revisions. The client owns the code outright with no platform
  lock-in. Ongoing maintenance and updates are available afterwards for a monthly rate.
- **Consultancy and existing site improvements. Quoted per case.** Work on systems and websites
  that already exist: making a site faster, easier to find and easier to use, migrating away from a
  page builder, reviewing a technical decision before it is committed to, or acting as the senior
  engineer a team can call on. No fixed price, since every case differs. Contact for a quote.

Custom work outside these packages is quoted on request.

## Experience

- **Hero Journey Club (2024-2026), Senior Software Engineer.** Real-time AI-driven mental health
  platform embedded in gaming ecosystems. Architected a real-time AI voice communication platform
  using speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, designed an event-driven AWS architecture with
  automated on-demand server provisioning, and led architecture and scalability strategy.
- **ImmobilienScout24 (2019-2024), Senior Software Engineer.** Full-stack development across 60+
  microservices on AWS, serverless event-driven systems under high-traffic production workloads,
  and CI/CD and reliability improvements across a multi-team microservice environment.
- **ErcoleDev (2016-2019), Lead Engineer and Freelancer.** Designed and scaled cloud infrastructure
  for early-stage startups in fintech, AI and streaming, serving as technical lead and CTO-level
  contributor for several European startups.

## Core skills

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Python, FastAPI, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge,
Step Functions, ECS, CDK, CloudFormation), serverless and event-driven architecture, microservices,
distributed systems, speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, agentic AI and Model Context
Protocol, workflow automation, PostgreSQL, Prisma, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD.

## Live websites

Sites built or maintained by Federico Ercole that are publicly reachable:

- https://www.ercole.dev, built and maintained. Static Next.js, deployed on push.
- https://forcecx.com, built and maintained. Site for an independent commissioning engineer
  serving industrial clients, with an enquiry form and content in English, Italian and German.
- https://globalcucina.com, built and maintained. Cooking and recipe site with recipes browsable by
  course and by cuisine, plus search and filtering.
- https://www.ferramatori.com, built and maintained. Official site of a railway culture association
  in Northern Italy.

Other work by Federico Ercole is listed under selected projects below, including client work for
the nautical licence school Nautiscuola and the Lupus Noctis Progressive Web App.

## Selected projects

- **xcore.gg**: unified gaming profile across Steam, Xbox and PlayStation. Next.js, Node.js, AWS,
  Prisma, PostgreSQL.
- **Midnight Heist**: Minecraft experience with NPCs driven by large language models, including
  live transcription and real-time voice responses.
- **Sursk.it**: full-stack Pokémon data application with a typed JSON API. Vue 3, FastAPI, Python.
- **Picks & Bans**: draft platform for Age of Empires II team matches. Next.js, Prisma, SSE.
- **Lupus Noctis**: Progressive Web App reimagining of the Werewolves party game.
